tasks.label: LAB126 — Auto-compila APK+ZIP all'apertura Codespaces (senza Actions)
args:
set -euo pipefail
branch='trial/studybook-lab126-deep-content-recovery-20261113'
[[ "$(git branch --show-current)" == "$branch" ]] || { echo '[LAB126] Apri il ramo LAB126 prima di compilare.' >&2; exit 1; }
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in
  https://github.com/Br174/StudyBook-AI|https://github.com/Br174/StudyBook-AI.git|git@github.com:Br174/StudyBook-AI.git|ssh://git@github.com/Br174/StudyBook-AI.git) ;;
  *) echo '[LAB126] Repository origin inatteso.' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
remote_ref="refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/heads/$branch:$remote_ref"
script="$(git show "$remote_ref:scripts/codespaces-lab126-autobuild.sh")"
[[ -n "$script" ]]
exec bash -c "$script" scripts/codespaces-lab126-autobuild.sh

tasks.label: LAB126 — Avvia Worker di prova e compila APK+ZIP (manuale)
